name: frame-header-tampered
description: The monotonic_ms field of the last of four frames edited, with the frame CRC recomputed.
asserts: A structural scan reaches EOF with four frames: the CRC is valid and the chain is intact. A keyed scan stops at that frame with AUTH_FAILED and retains the three before it, because the 24-byte frame header is authenticated as AAD. A timestamp cannot be rewritten by anyone without the key.
